title.narrative: This activity will contribute to achieving results for the SERVICES DELIVERY AND STRENGTHEN NUTRITION SYSTEMS output

description.narrative: Systems to ensure improved and equitable access to nutritional interventions for age-appropriate diets, practices and services for young children, adolescents and women are strengthened. This work breakdown structure activity contributed to sublevel results - Nutrition in early childhood,Nutrition of adolescents and women,Early detection and treatment of malnutrition,Life saving interventions,Prevention of stunting and other forms of malnutrition,Detection and treatment of child wasting,Prevention of anemia, low birthweight, overweight, and other forms of malnutrition,Cross sectoral - Social and behaviour change

title.narrative: Integrated nutrition efforts improved children's diets and care practices through health, food, education, and social protection systems. Vitamin A supplementation reached 438,455 children, while 734,265 pregnant women received iron and folic acid (IFA) or multiple micronutrient supplements (MMS). There were 605,705 caregivers receiving counselling, and 91,819 households adopting food diversification schemes, enhancing dietary diversity and access to nutrient-rich foods.
